credits.title: Aakasamlo Oka Tara
credits.overview: A girl from a remote village dreams of becoming an astronaut and wishes to defy the odds and doubts from those around her.
Set in a medical college in a dread-stricken village, the film confronts the science behind superstitions, the superstitions in science, and an anomaly that neither can explain.

credits.title: Bachhala Malli
credits.overview: The story is set in the 1990s and follows the emotional and action-filled journey of Bachhala Malli, a rural hero. The narrative combines intense drama with romance, focusing on the protagonist’s challenges and personal growth in a rustic backdrop.

credits.title: KA
credits.overview: Set in 1970s Abhinaya Vasudev, an orphaned and happy-go-lucky postman, treats the Krishnagiri village populace as his extended family. When several women missing and Vasudev’s loved one is nearly abducted, he is determined to find answers.

credits.title: Viraaji
credits.overview: A stand-up comic, gynecologist, hotel manager, police officer and a drug addict, among others reach an abandoned mental asylum by a mysterious host, who informs them that they would all be dead by dawn for their past sins and proceeds killing. Will they live to see another day?

credits.title: The Family Star
credits.overview: Govardhan, a devoted architect from Hyderabad, juggles supporting his extended family while seeking a partner who understands his commitments. credits.title: Balagam
credits.overview: A boisterous, bawdy, meddling village patriarch Komurayya’s death just before the engagement changes the course of  his grandson Saayilu's life and the other family members, rattling some skeletons in the closet, exposing the rifts present within the family, causing bigger sociological calamities in the small village.
